# Aight

> Aight is an OpenAI-compatible API for 102 AI models — text, voice and image —
> from OpenAI, Google, Amazon, NVIDIA, Mistral and others, through one API key.
> Billed in USD. Usage earns 10% back in credits. Higher token limits and India
> hosting options are available for supported workloads. Built and operated by
> Ashva Intelligence Pvt Ltd.

## Docs
- [Quickstart](https://getaight.ai/docs/): first request, authentication, base URL
- [API reference](https://getaight.ai/docs/reference/): endpoints and parameters
- [The Aight API](https://getaight.ai/api/): address, curl and Python examples, error codes

## Models and pricing
- [Model catalogue](https://getaight.ai/models/): 102 models with input/output prices per 1M tokens

## Rewards
- [Credits back](https://getaight.ai/credits/): 10% back in credits on AI usage

## Company
- [Enterprise](https://getaight.ai/enterprise/): higher capacity, India hosting, custom deployment
- [Contact](https://getaight.ai/contact/)
- [Support](https://getaight.ai/support/)
- [Status](https://getaight.ai/status/)
